note: 週末教學 post（Tim 2026-10-12）：星期六日各一集，由 start 起計第 1 集，最後一集後返第 1 集（第 27 集宏觀分頁 2026-10-13 加）。文案由 Claude 寫好，Grok bot 照貼。{TK}/{TKL}/{ACC}/{LANG} 由 tools/tutorial.py 每次換做當時最多人講嘅股票同帳號。 2026-10-27 Tim：加第 28–34 集（10/12 之後嘅新功能），new_first 由 from 嗰個星期六起先播一輪，播完先返原本輪次。 2026-10-29 Tim：書本式上線，第 7–19、30 集「點用」改成第幾頁，加第 35 集（一頁頁睇）。 2026-10-29 Tim：中文改用普通話書面語，文案不放網址。

zh.t: 一頁看懂 {N} 個 X 美股大神在說什麼
zh.b:
我們追蹤 X 上 {N} 個美股大神、宏觀分析和市場快訊帳號，把他們對每檔股票的看多、看空和中性立場整理成一頁。
我們不加自己的意見，只告訴你大神們在做什麼。
zh.how: 打開網站，第一頁就是今天大神們的共識。

en.t: {N} top X stock accounts, on one page
en.b:
We track {N} top US-stock, macro and market-news accounts on X, and turn their bullish, bearish and neutral views on each stock into one page.
No opinions of our own: just what the crowd is doing.
en.how: Open the site; the first page is today's consensus.

zh.t: 免費、不用登入、不用裝 app
zh.b:
The Crowd Tape 完全免費，不用開戶、不用登入，用手機瀏覽器打開就能看。
沒有付費牆，也沒有會員專區，每個人看到的數據都一樣。
zh.how: 點頁面頂部的「儲存網站」：Chrome 和 Android 一點就裝好；iPhone 跟著兩個步驟「加入主畫面」，之後就能像 app 一樣打開。

en.t: Free. No login. No app.
en.b:
The Crowd Tape is completely free. No account and no login: just open it in your phone's browser.
No paywall and no members-only area; everyone sees the same data.
en.how: Tap "Save site" at the top: one tap on Chrome and Android; on iPhone follow the two steps to Add to Home Screen, then open it like an app.

zh.t: 每 4 小時自動更新一次
zh.b:
網站每 4 小時自動抓取新貼文、更新股價和共識，全天候不停。
頁面頂部寫明「帖文資料截至」和「下次更新」的時間，數據有多新一眼就知道。
zh.how: 看頁面頂部「帖文資料截至」那一行。

en.t: Updated automatically every 4 hours
en.b:
Every 4 hours the site pulls in new posts and refreshes prices and consensus, day and night.
The top of the page shows "Posts as of" and "Next update", so you always know how fresh the numbers are.
en.how: Look for "Posts as of" at the top of the page.

zh.t: 追蹤名單：那 {N} 個帳號是誰？
zh.b:
「追蹤名單」列出全部 {N} 個帳號，分成名人與企業家、美股分析、宏觀、市場快訊等類別，每個都有頭像和簡介。
網站只會收錄這 {N} 個帳號的觀點，不會隨便加人。
zh.how: 點頂部的「追蹤名單」分頁。

en.t: The tracked list: who are the {N} accounts?
en.b:
The "Tracked list" tab shows all {N} accounts, grouped into business leaders, stock analysts, macro, market news and more, each with an avatar and a short bio.
Only these {N} accounts ever appear on the site.
en.how: Tap the "Tracked list" tab at the top.

zh.t: 中文、English 一鍵切換
zh.b:
網站有中文和英文兩個版本，內容一樣，連大神貼文的摘要都有翻譯。
點頁面頂部的「中 / EN」就能切換，分享給外國朋友也沒問題。
zh.how: 點頁面頂部的「中 EN」。

en.t: Chinese or English: one tap to switch
en.b:
The site comes in Chinese and English, with the same data in both, including summaries of the accounts' posts.
Tap "中 / EN" at the top to switch, and share it with friends in either language.
en.how: Tap "中 EN" at the top.

zh.t: 為 iPhone 設計，單手就能用
zh.b:
網站是按手機設計的：卡片式排版、字體夠大，長清單先顯示前幾項，點「再顯示」才看全部。
右下角有「↑」一鍵回到頂部，搭車、排隊時也能快速看看大神們今天說了什麼。
zh.how: 用手機打開網站，點任何一張帳號卡片試試。

en.t: Built for your phone
en.b:
The site is designed for phones: card layout, readable text, and long lists that show the first items with a "show more" button.
The ↑ button in the corner takes you back to the top. Check what the crowd is saying on the bus or in a queue.
en.how: Open it on your phone and tap any account card.

zh.t: 「共同看多」：幾位大神一起看多的股票
zh.b:
「共同看多」是指至少 2 個帳號最新立場都是看多的股票，還會列出是哪幾個帳號。
不是一個人說了就算，要幾個人方向一致才會上榜。
zh.how: 點「每週」分頁，翻到第 2 頁「共識與分歧」就能看到共同看多。

en.t: "Consensus bullish": stocks several accounts like
en.b:
"Consensus bullish" lists stocks where at least 2 accounts' latest view is bullish, and shows which accounts they are.
One loud voice is not enough; it takes several pointing the same way.
en.how: Tap the "Weekly" tab and turn to page 2, "Consensus and splits".

zh.t: 「共同看空」：大神們一起看空哪一檔？
zh.b:
和共同看多一樣，「共同看空」列出至少 2 個帳號最新立場都是看空的股票。
買入之前看看有沒有人一起唱空，是很有用的提醒。
zh.how: 「每日」「每週」「每月」分頁都有共同看空：每日在第 5 頁，每週和每月在第 2 頁。

en.t: "Consensus bearish": what is the crowd selling?
en.b:
Like Consensus bullish, "Consensus bearish" lists stocks where at least 2 accounts' latest view is bearish.
Before you buy, it is worth checking whether several people are warning against it.
en.how: Daily (page 5), Weekly and Monthly (page 2) all show Consensus bearish.

zh.t: 「多空分歧」：哪檔股票最有爭議？
zh.b:
有些股票有人看多、有人看空，網站會把它們放在「多空分歧」，寫明幾個看多、幾個看空。
爭議大的股票通常波動也大，進場前值得先看清楚兩邊的理由。
zh.how: 點「每週」分頁翻到第 2 頁，點任何一檔股票，就能看到兩邊大神怎麼說。

en.t: "Split": which stocks divide the crowd?
en.b:
When some accounts are bullish and others bearish on the same stock, it shows up under "Split", with the count on each side.
Split stocks are often volatile, so read both sides before you act.
en.how: Turn to page 2 of the "Weekly" tab and tap any stock to see what each side says.

zh.t: 「市場關注度變化」：哪檔股票正在變熱？
zh.b:
每檔股票一條橫條：顏色分成看多、中性、未表態和看空，括號是和上一期相比多了還是少了人討論。
已經沒人討論的股票會自動篩走；突然很多人討論的，往往就是市場的下一個焦點。
zh.how: 「每日」分頁第 4 頁「市場關注度變化」。

en.t: "Attention shifts": what is heating up?
en.b:
One bar per stock, split into bullish, neutral, no view and bearish, with the change versus last period in brackets.
Stocks nobody talks about any more drop off; a stock that suddenly gets attention is often the market's next focus.
en.how: "Attention shifts" on page 4 of the Daily tab.

zh.t: 「各帳號立場」：每檔股票誰看多、誰看空
zh.b:
每檔股票一行，按討論的帳號數量排序；大神頭像分成看多、看空、中性和未表態幾組，還附一句看多和看空的理由。
上方可以選「有分歧」「多人看多」「多人看空」，點一行就能看到每個帳號的最新說法。
zh.how: 「每日」分頁第 5 頁「各帳號立場」，點任何一行。

en.t: "Stance by account": who is bullish or bearish on each stock
en.b:
One row per stock, ranked by how many accounts discussed it, with avatars grouped into bullish, bearish, neutral and no view, plus a one-line reason for each side.
Filter by "split", "many bullish" or "many bearish", and tap a row to see each account's latest take.
en.how: "Stance by account" on page 5 of the Daily tab; tap any row.

zh.t: 「重要觀點」：大神轉向第一時間知道
zh.b:
「重要觀點」會優先列出立場有變的貼文，例如由看多轉看空，以及說得最明確的表態。
每則都附中文摘要和原帖，不用自己逐個帳號翻。
zh.how: 「每日」分頁翻到第 6 頁就能看到「重要觀點」。

en.t: "Key views": catch every change of mind
en.b:
"Key views" puts stance changes first, like an account flipping from bullish to bearish, followed by the clearest calls.
Each comes with a summary and the original post, so you don't have to scroll through every account.
en.how: Turn to page 6 of the Daily tab for "Key views".

zh.t: 「今日市場分析」：一段話幫你總結今天
zh.b:
沒空逐則看？「今日市場分析」用幾段文字總結今天大神們最關心的股票、宏觀消息和分歧。
通勤的幾分鐘就能看完。
zh.how: 「每日」分頁第 2 頁「今日市場分析」。

en.t: "Today's market analysis": the day in a few paragraphs
en.b:
No time to read every post? "Today's market analysis" sums up the stocks, macro news and disagreements the accounts cared about most.
Read it in a few minutes on your commute.
en.how: "Today's market analysis" on page 2 of the Daily tab.

zh.t: 「本週重點」：7 天內大神們說了什麼
zh.b:
「每週」分頁把過去 7 天整理在一起：本週重點、共同看多看空、高度一致和明顯分歧。
週末花 5 分鐘，就能追上整個星期。
zh.how: 點頂部的「每週」分頁，第 1 頁就是本週重點。

en.t: "This week's highlights": 7 days in one view
en.b:
The Weekly tab rolls up the last 7 days: highlights, consensus bullish and bearish, strong agreement and clear splits.
Five minutes on the weekend and you're caught up on the whole week.
en.how: Tap the "Weekly" tab at the top; page 1 is the week's highlights.

zh.t: 「每月」：28 天的看多與看空比例
zh.b:
「每月」分頁統計 28 天內所有貼文，看大神們整體偏樂觀還是偏悲觀，還有本月趨勢總結。
過濾掉短期噪音，大方向更清楚。
zh.how: 點「每月」分頁，翻到第 3 頁「看多與看空比例」。

en.t: "Monthly": the 28-day bull vs bear ratio
en.b:
The Monthly tab counts 28 days of posts to show whether the crowd leans optimistic or pessimistic, plus a monthly trends summary.
Short-term noise filtered out, the big picture gets clearer.
en.how: Tap "Monthly" and turn to page 3, "Bullish vs bearish".

zh.t: 「立場一致性」：哪位大神經常轉向？
zh.b:
網站會計算每個帳號對同一檔股票前後立場有多一致，還會統計「反轉」次數（由看多直接變看空，或者反過來）。
經常轉向還是很有堅持，一看就知道。
zh.how: 「每月」分頁第 3 頁「帳號立場的一致性」。

en.t: "Stance consistency": who flip-flops?
en.b:
For each account, the site measures how consistent its stance on the same stock has been, and counts outright reversals (bullish straight to bearish or back).
See at a glance who sticks to their calls.
en.how: "Stance consistency by account" on page 3 of the Monthly tab.

zh.t: 熱力圖：每檔股票每天的熱度和立場
zh.b:
每格代表一天：顏色代表當天大神們淨看多還是淨看空，深淺代表討論人數；只列出至少 3 個帳號討論、熱度維持至少 3 天的股票。
一檔股票什麼時候開始變熱、立場什麼時候轉向，整個月一張圖看完。
zh.how: 「每月」分頁第 6 頁「個股關注度與觀點隨時間的變化」。

en.t: Heat map: buzz and stance, day by day
en.b:
Each square is one day: the colour shows whether the accounts were net bullish or bearish, and the shade shows how many talked about it. Only stocks with 3+ accounts on 3+ days are listed.
See when a stock heated up and when views turned, a whole month in one picture.
en.how: "Stock attention and views over time" on page 6 of the Monthly tab.

zh.t: 每位大神本月最看好哪檔股票？
zh.b:
網站幫每個帳號找出本月最多次明確看多的股票，再附上近 1 年回報。
想知道 Elon Musk 或你最喜歡的分析師最支持哪一檔，一眼就看到。
zh.how: 「每月」分頁第 4 頁「每個帳號本月最看好的股票」。

en.t: Each account's top pick this month
en.b:
For every account, the site finds the stock it called bullish most often this month, with its 1-year return.
See which stock your favourite analyst backs most.
en.how: "Each account's top stock this month" on page 4 of the Monthly tab.

zh.t: 「股票排行榜」：28 天內最多人討論哪檔
zh.b:
排行榜列出 28 天內所有被提及的股票，有提及次數、多空比例和一年回報。
點表頭就能重新排序，自己選要看最熱門還是最多人看多。
zh.how: 「每月」分頁第 5 頁「股票排行榜」，點表頭排序。

en.t: "Stock leaderboard": the 28-day ranking
en.b:
The leaderboard lists every stock mentioned in 28 days, with mentions, bull/bear mix and 1-year return.
Tap a column header to re-sort by what you care about.
en.how: "Stock leaderboard" on page 5 of the Monthly tab; tap a header to sort.

zh.t: 帳號頁：大神說過的話全都在這裡
zh.b:
點任何一個帳號，就能看到他所有貼文（由新到舊）、提過哪些股票，以及每檔股票的立場怎樣變化。
追蹤一位大神之前，先看看他過去說得準不準。
zh.how: 點任何帳號卡片或帳號名稱。

en.t: Account pages: everything one account said
en.b:
Tap any account to see all its posts (newest first), the stocks it mentioned and how its stance on each changed.
Before you follow someone, check their track record.
en.how: Tap any account card or name.

zh.t: 個股頁：每檔股票都有自己的一頁
zh.b:
被 2 個或以上帳號討論過的股票都有獨立頁面：收市價、28 天漲跌、幾個看多幾個看空，以及每個帳號的最新觀點和理由。
用 Google 就能搜到，也可以直接分享給朋友。
zh.how: 在網站搜尋股票代號，例如 {TK}，就會打開它的個股頁。

en.t: Stock pages: every stock gets its own page
en.b:
Any stock mentioned by 2 or more accounts gets its own page: close, 28-day change, bull and bear counts, and each account's latest view and reasoning.
Find it on Google or send the link to a friend.
en.how: Search the site for a ticker, such as {TK}, and its stock page opens.

zh.t: 搜尋股票：輸入代號或公司名稱
zh.b:
想看某一檔股票？點分頁列右邊的 🔍，輸入代號（例如 {TK}）或公司名稱，結果馬上彈出來，還能看到有幾個帳號討論過。
在 iPhone 上 🔍 會固定在頂部，滑到多下面都點得到。
zh.how: 點分頁列右邊的 🔍。

en.t: Search: type a ticker or company name
en.b:
Looking for a stock? Tap 🔍 at the right of the tab bar and type a ticker (like {TK}) or a company name; it pops up right away with how many accounts mentioned it.
On iPhone the 🔍 sticks to the top, so it's always within reach.
en.how: Tap 🔍 at the right of the tab bar.

zh.t: 推論依據和時間長度：大神為什麼這樣想？
zh.b:
每個觀點都會標明理由是技術面、基本面、宏觀還是催化劑，以及說的是短線、中線還是長線。
同樣看多，有人看圖、有人看業績，你可以選和自己風格合適的。
zh.how: 點一檔股票，看「共識與分歧」。

en.t: Reasoning and time frame: why do they think so?
en.b:
Each view is tagged with its reasoning (technicals, fundamentals, macro or a catalyst) and its horizon (short, medium or long term).
Two bulls can have very different reasons; pick the ones that match your style.
en.how: Tap a stock and look at "Consensus and splits".

zh.t: 發帖時股價：大神說完之後是漲是跌？
zh.b:
個股圖表上每一點是一位大神的觀點，點下去會看到他發帖時的股價，以及是看多還是看空。
對照之後的走勢，就知道誰說得準。
zh.how: 點一檔股票，再點圖表上的點。

en.t: Price at post: did it go up after the call?
en.b:
Every dot on a stock's chart is one account's view. Tap it to see the price when they posted and whether they were bullish or bearish.
Compare with what happened next to see who called it right.
en.how: Tap a stock, then tap a dot on its chart.

zh.t: 每個觀點都附原帖，自己核對
zh.b:
網站的摘要和立場由 AI 整理，所以每則都附上「原始貼文」，一點就回到 X 看原文。
不用只相信我們，自己看清楚。
zh.how: 每則觀點右上角的「原始貼文 ↗」。

en.t: Every view links to the original post
en.b:
Summaries and stances on the site are produced by AI, so every one links to the "Original post" on X, one tap away.
Don't take our word for it; check it yourself.
en.how: Tap "Original post ↗" on any view.

zh.t: 每日快照：追蹤 @thecrowdtape
zh.b:
每逢星期一至五，我們都會發一張「X 大神快照」：今天最多人看多、最多人討論的股票，以及共同看多和看空。
追蹤 @thecrowdtape，每天早上一張圖就知道市場在想什麼。
zh.how: 追蹤 @thecrowdtape，或者用 RSS 訂閱網站。

en.t: Daily snapshot: follow @thecrowdtape
en.b:
Every weekday we post an "X crowd snapshot": today's most-liked and most-discussed stocks, plus consensus bullish and bearish.
Follow @thecrowdtape and get the crowd's read in one picture each morning.
en.how: Follow @thecrowdtape, or subscribe to the site's RSS feed.

zh.t: 宏觀分頁：{N} 個帳號怎麼看大環境
zh.b:
聯儲局、通脹、債息、油價、關稅……{N} 個帳號談宏觀，我們按 9 個主題分好組。
每個主題都能看到多少人覺得對美股利好、利空或中性，和上星期相比是轉好還是轉差，點開就有每個人的最新說法。
zh.how: 點分頁列的「宏觀」。

en.t: Macro tab: how {N} accounts see the big picture
en.b:
The Fed, inflation, bond yields, oil, tariffs: when the {N} accounts talk macro, we sort it into 9 topics.
For each topic you see how many think it is bullish, bearish or neutral for US stocks, whether that is better or worse than last week, and tap to read everyone's latest take.
en.how: Tap "Macro" in the tab bar.

zh.t: 財報簡報：大型股業績一頁看完
zh.b:
市值 500 億美元以上的美股，每家公司最新一季財報都整理成 5 章：結果與預期、成長率、收入線、利潤率和現金流。
數字來自 SEC 文件和 Yahoo Finance，每 4 小時自動更新，列表還有搜尋和每家公司的預覽卡。
zh.how: 點分頁列的「最新財報簡報」。

en.t: Earnings briefs: big-cap results on one page
en.b:
Every US stock worth $50B+ gets its latest quarter in 5 chapters: results vs estimates, growth, revenue lines, margins and cash flow.
Numbers come from SEC filings and Yahoo Finance and refresh every 4 hours; the list has search and a preview card for each company.
en.how: Tap "Latest earnings briefs" in the tab row.

zh.t: 熱門個股：7 天內最多人討論哪幾檔
zh.b:
「熱門個股」列出過去 7 天大神們提得最多的股票和提及次數，例如 {TK}。
點代號就直接打開那檔股票的個股頁，看每個帳號怎麼說。
zh.how: 首頁的「熱門個股」，點任何一個代號。

en.t: Hot stocks: most talked about in 7 days
en.b:
"Hot stocks" lists the stocks the accounts mentioned most over the past 7 days, with the count, such as {TK}.
Tap a ticker to go straight to its stock page and see what each account says.
en.how: "Hot stocks" on the homepage; tap any ticker.

zh.t: 「今日三句重點」：10 秒知道今天發生什麼
zh.b:
打開網站，第一格就是「今日三句重點」：共識變化最大、最多人討論和最大分歧，三句話說完。
每句都附股票代號，點下去就能看詳細內容。
zh.how: 打開網站，「每日」分頁第 1 頁。

en.t: "Today in 3 lines": the day in 10 seconds
en.b:
The first box on the site is "Today in 3 lines": the biggest consensus shift, the most discussed stock and the biggest split, in three sentences.
Each line has a ticker you can tap for the details.
en.how: Open the site; it is on page 1 of the Daily tab.

zh.t: 個股頁的 TradingView 圖表：看完多空馬上驗證
zh.b:
每個個股頁都嵌入了 TradingView 走勢圖，可以放大縮小、切換時間範圍。
看完大神們看多還是看空之後，自己對照圖表核實一下走勢。
zh.how: 打開任何個股頁，例如 {TK}，滑到「走勢圖」。

en.t: TradingView chart on every stock page
en.b:
Every stock page has a TradingView chart built in: zoom, pan and change the time range.
After reading the bulls and bears, check the price action yourself.
en.how: Open any stock page, such as {TK}, and scroll to the chart.

zh.t: 深色模式：跟著你的手機自動切換
zh.b:
網站會跟隨你手機或電腦的設定：白天是白底，開了深色模式就自動變成黑底。
晚上躺在床上看也不刺眼。
zh.how: 在 iPhone「設定 > 螢幕顯示與亮度」選「深色」，再打開網站。

en.t: Dark mode that follows your phone
en.b:
The site follows your phone or computer setting: light by day, and black automatically when dark mode is on.
Easy on the eyes at night.
en.how: Turn on Dark in iPhone Settings > Display & Brightness, then open the site.

zh.t: 工具頁：我們用來核實「群眾」的工具
zh.b:
統計多空不等於買賣訊號。「工具」頁介紹我們自己在用的 TradingView（看圖）和 Stock Rover（估值和基本面），每個都寫明好處。
部分是聯盟推廣，不影響多空統計。
zh.how: 點頁面頂部的「工具」。

en.t: Tools page: what we use to check the crowd
en.b:
Bull and bear counts are not trade signals. The Tools page shows what we use ourselves: TradingView for charts and Stock Rover for valuation and fundamentals, with the benefits of each.
Some are affiliate links; they never affect the counts.
en.how: Tap "Tools" at the top.

zh.t: 每週電子報：多空統計直接寄到你的信箱
zh.b:
不想每天打開網站？訂閱每週電子報，每星期一封，總結整個星期大神們的多空統計。
免費、隨時可以取消，過往各期都能在網站上看到。
zh.how: 點頁面底部的「電子報」，輸入電郵再點「訂閱」。

en.t: Weekly newsletter: the crowd in your inbox
en.b:
Not opening the site every day? Get the weekly newsletter: one email a week with the bull and bear counts.
Free, cancel any time, and past issues are on the site.
en.how: Tap "Newsletter" at the bottom of the page, enter your email and tap Subscribe.

zh.t: 一頁一頁看：每頁 5 分鐘內看完
zh.b:
資訊太多看不完？現在每日、每週、每月都分成幾頁，像看書一樣，每頁一個主題，5 分鐘內看完就點「下一頁」。
頂部的頁碼可以跳到任何一頁；手機上可以左右滑；想一次看完就點「全部展開」，下次會記住。
zh.how: 打開網站，在頁面底部點「下一頁」，或者在頂部點頁碼。

en.t: Read it page by page: each page in under 5 minutes
en.b:
Too much to take in? Daily, Weekly and Monthly are now split into short pages like a book, one topic each, so you can finish a page in under 5 minutes and tap "Next".
Tap a page number at the top to jump; swipe on your phone; or tap "Show all" to see everything at once, and the site remembers.
en.how: Open the site and tap "Next" at the bottom, or a page number at the top.
